title: When Harmless Words Harm: A New Threat to LLM Safety via Conceptual Triggers

bias_targets.methodology: Using a jailbreak attack method called Morphology Inspired Conceptual Manipulation (MICM) that injects concept-embedded triggers (CETs) into prompts about real-world socio-political incidents, and measuring the generated text's alignment with extremist ideologies (specifically neo-Nazism) using a qualitative LLM-as-a-judge metric called the Ideological Alignment Score (IAS).
